title: 正文 第七章 深海一族
content_zh:
云里石头开锦缝，从来不许嵌斜阳。何人仰见通霄路，一尺青天万丈长。

    隘口宽三丈，两边石壁光滑，似刀劈斧砍般。幻天仰头观看，上方的天空已微不可见。一步迈入绝壁隘口，仿佛进入了恶兽之口，视线也变得模糊不清。

    “陆典兄，外面的两位美女就交给你了，我进去探探路。”幻天回头对着陆典说道。

    “幻兄，不如我和你一起，也好互相有个照应。”

    “不必了，里面地势逼仄，不利于多人作战。在说了，我以武入道，在这种不能使用灵力的地方，我比较有优势。”不待陆典回答，幻天便深入隘口之中。

    随着行走，一阵血腥味传来，并且在逐渐加重，到最后甚至有些刺鼻。嗅着空气中的血腥味，幻天皱眉，再凝三分心神。

    “这里石壁残破，巨大的石块也散落的到处都是，看来先前的战斗十分强烈。”幻天自语。

    幻天越过一块巨大的石块，看着石壁上的剑痕以及地上的裂纹，还有地上到处散落的血液。幻天猜测：“所有的战斗痕迹都在这一小段的隘口之中，当时的战斗一定是在瞬间发生的，可为什么只有血液没有尸体？”

    幻天疑惑，继续向前行走，又越过几块巨石。这才发现七八具尸体，不过没有一具是完整的，尸体断口如同破絮，是被强行撕开的。可以看出杀害他们的东西很残忍，并且力大无穷。

    正当幻天检查尸体之时，一股暴虐的杀机传来。感受这股杀机幻天猛然后退，而在他后退之路上一点寒光突然闪现，一柄利剑以刁钻的角度袭来，封锁了他所有的退路。

    幻天震动脚掌，力之极尽爆发，冲天而起。上方却出现一方大印，状若板砖，轰然落下。后有凌厉剑芒，上有沉重大印，最让幻天有危机感的是刚才传来杀机之人。

    “成圣封神。”幻天大呵。双手划动神秘轨迹，一层人形光幕浮现，笼罩己身。撑开唯一本我秘藏，幻天忽略来至后方的凌厉剑招以及上方的沉重大印，运转斗战圣法冲向前方。

    “力印。”突然一声熟悉的言语传来，幻天凝眸一看，竟然是苍岚，同时苍岚也看见了他。不过两人招式已出，已无回旋余地。双方都是以武入道，出手皆是势大力沉。一个运用斗战圣法，战斗无双，一个使用本门最强印法之一。

    两强相撞，石破天惊，如同无数道闷雷在耳边炸响。幻天有成圣封神守护，只是翻滚飞出，并无异样。而苍岚则被巨大的反震力，撞的翻滚飞出，镶入了石壁之中，吐出了一口污血。

    看着被击成重伤的苍岚，不明原因的徐辉与能忍小和尚转过头来，疯狂的进攻幻天。两人看着同伴受伤，早已动了真怒，出手皆是狠辣无情，不留丝毫后手。而认出他们的幻天，只能被动防守，根本就没有时间解释。

    “停下，是自己人。”苍岚震动四肢，石壁龟裂，走出石壁后他大喊。

    “什么，是自己人。”徐辉惊疑，同能忍小和尚一起后退，停下了攻势。

    “小师傅，你这下手够狠啊！”幻天揉捏肿胀的手臂，看着能忍小和尚手里的金砖说道。

    “原来是幻兄，你这……你这变化也太大了！不能怪我们没认出你。”徐辉打着哈哈。

    “看来幻施主伤势恢复了，不过这皮可是够硬的，我这无往不利的闷头砖都干不动你。”能忍小和尚哈哈一笑说道，从他调侃的语气中幻天听出，对于见到他，他们还是很高兴的。

    “对了，你的头发怎么……”徐辉说了半句又停下来了。可能是觉得问人这种问题，比较唐突。

    “也没什么，就是出了点意外，差点死去。先不说我，你们是怎么一回事，好像不太顺利啊！还有，乐萱妹子呢。”看着几人脏乱的衣服，幻天询问。

    听到幻天提起乐萱，来到几人身边的苍岚有些激动，散发出一丝丝暴虐的杀机，很是愤怒。

    “怎么回事。”幻天看向徐辉。

    “是这样的，那天我们分散以后，各自都遇到了一些危险，后来我们四人在残破的古城中再次相遇。期间虽然发生了一些困难，但在几人同心协力下，都安然度过。就在今天我们遇见了深海一族，它们向来和人族井水不犯河水。可不知为什么，这一次它们像是磕了药一般，对我人族大肆杀虐。同我们一起来的十几人，皆被它们残杀。就在刚刚，他们掠走了乐萱。”

    “深海一族？你们没有反抗吗？为什么一具他们的尸体都没有。”幻天疑惑。

    “看来幻兄的记忆还是没有恢复，深海一族生活在深海中，在深海水压的影响下，它们肉身先天强于我们人族，在这不能使用灵力的遗落之地，我们处于极大的弱势，虽说有苍岚兄和能忍小和尚在，但终究寡不敌众，被它们残杀了那么多人族不说，乐萱妹子还被掠走了。”徐辉遗憾。“如若是能使用灵力，又何惧这些虾兵蟹将。”

    “他们为什么会掠走乐萱妹子。”

    “因为他们看中了师妹的‘通灵仙体’。”一直没说话的苍岚回答了幻天的问题。

    “既然如此，那么就证明乐萱妹子暂时不会有危险。我们还有时间补救。”幻天安慰苍岚。
content_en:
The stones in the clouds are made of brocade seams, but they are never allowed to be embedded in the setting sun.Who can look up and see the road leading to the sky? The blue sky is one foot long and ten thousand feet long.
The pass is three feet wide, and the stone walls on both sides are smooth, as if it were chopped with a knife or an axe.Huantian looked up and saw that the sky above was barely visible.Taking a step into the cliff pass, it felt like entering the mouth of an evil beast, and the vision became blurred.
"Brother Lu Dian, I'll leave the two beauties outside to you. I'll go in and explore the way." Huantian turned around and said to Lu Dian.
"Brother Huan, why don't you and I come together so that we can take care of each other?"
"No need, the terrain inside is cramped, which is not conducive to multiple people fighting. As I said, I use martial arts to enter the Tao. In a place like this where spiritual power cannot be used, I have an advantage." Without waiting for Lu Dian's answer, Huantian went deep into the pass.
As he walked, the smell of blood came, and it gradually became stronger, and in the end it was even pungent.Smelling the smell of blood in the air, Huantian frowned and concentrated again.
"The stone walls here are broken, and huge stones are scattered everywhere. It seems that the previous battle was very intense." Huantian said to himself.
Huantian crossed a huge stone and looked at the sword marks on the stone wall, the cracks on the ground, and the blood scattered everywhere on the ground.Huantian guessed: "All the traces of the battle are in this small pass. The battle must have happened in an instant, but why is there only blood and no corpses?"
Huantian was confused and continued walking forward, crossing several more boulders.Only then were seven or eight corpses discovered, but none of them was complete. The fractures of the corpses were like rags, which had been torn open by force.It can be seen that the thing that killed them was cruel and extremely powerful.
Just as Huantian was inspecting the body, a violent murderous intention came.Feeling this murderous intent, he retreated violently, and a cold light suddenly flashed on his way back, and a sharp sword struck at an awkward angle, blocking all his retreat routes.
Huantian shook the soles of his feet, and exploded with all his strength, rising into the sky.A large seal appeared above, shaped like a brick, and fell with a crash.There was a sharp sword light behind him, and there was a heavy seal on it. What made Huantian feel the most dangerous was the person who had just sent murderous intent.
"Become a saint or a god." Huantian shouted.His hands traced a mysterious trajectory, and a human-shaped light curtain emerged, covering his body.Opening the only secret of his identity, Huantian ignored the sharp sword moves coming from behind and the heavy seal above, and rushed forward using the holy magic of fighting.
"Strength Seal." Suddenly a familiar voice came. Huantian looked at it and saw that it was Cang Lan. At the same time, Cang Lan also saw him.However, the two of them had already used their moves and there was no room for maneuver.Both sides use martial arts to enter the Tao, and their attacks are both powerful and heavy.One uses the Holy Technique of Fighting and is unparalleled in combat, while the other uses one of the strongest seal techniques in the sect.
The collision between the two powerful forces was shocking, like countless muffled thunder exploding in the ears.Huantian is guarded by saints and conferred gods, but it just rolls and flies out, nothing unusual.Cang Lan, on the other hand, was hit by the huge force of the shock, rolled over and flew out, embedded in the stone wall, and spat out a mouthful of dirty blood.
Seeing Cang Lan who was seriously injured, Xu Hui and the young monk Nengren turned their heads and attacked Huantian crazily for unknown reasons.Seeing their companions being injured, the two of them had already become truly angry, and their attacks were ruthless and ruthless, leaving no room for hindrance.Huantian, who recognized them, could only defend passively and had no time to explain.
"Stop, it's one of our own." Cang Lan shook his limbs and the stone wall cracked. He shouted after walking out of the stone wall.
"What, it's one of our own." Xu Hui was surprised and retreated with the tolerant young monk, stopping the offensive.
"Little Master, you are so cruel!" Huantian rubbed his swollen arm and said while looking at the gold brick in the hands of the young monk.
"It turns out to be Brother Huan, you... you have changed so much! You can't blame us for not recognizing you." Xu Hui laughed.
"It seems that Huan Donor has recovered from his injuries, but your skin is very hard. Even my all-powerful scumbag can't fuck you." The tolerant little monk said with a laugh. From his teasing tone, Huantian could tell that they were still very happy to see him.
"By the way, what's wrong with your hair..." Xu Hui stopped mid-sentence.Maybe it’s because I think it’s a bit abrupt to ask someone this kind of question.
"It's nothing, I just had an accident and almost died. Let's not talk about me, what happened to you, it doesn't seem to be going well! And, where is Miss Le Xuan." Looking at the dirty clothes of several people, Huantian asked.
Hearing Huantian mention Le Xuan, Cang Lan, who came to a few people, was a little excited, exuding a trace of violent murderous intent, and was very angry.
"What's going on?" Huantian looked at Xu Hui.
"It's like this. After we dispersed that day, each of us encountered some dangers. Later, the four of us met again in the dilapidated ancient city. Although there were some difficulties during the period, with the concerted efforts of a few people, we all got through it safely. Just today we metThey have always been at odds with the human race, but for some reason, this time they slaughtered the dozen or so people who came with us, and they just kidnapped Le Xuan."
"The Deep Sea Clan? Didn't you resist? Why are there not even one of their corpses?" Huantian was confused.
"It seems that Brother Huan's memory has not been restored. The Deep Sea clan lives in the deep sea. Under the influence of deep water pressure, their bodies are inherently stronger than our human race. In this forgotten land where spiritual power cannot be used, we are at a great disadvantage. Although Brother Canglan and the young monk Nengren are here, we are ultimately outnumbered. Not only have they killed so many people, but also sister Le Xuan has been taken away." Xu Hui regretted."If you can use spiritual power, why be afraid of these shrimp soldiers and crab generals."
"Why did they take away Miss Le Xuan?"
"Because they took a fancy to junior sister's 'Psychic Immortal Body'." Cang Lan, who had been silent for the whole time, answered Huantian's question.
"In this case, it proves that sister Le Xuan will not be in danger for the time being. We still have time to remedy the situation." Huantian comforted Cang Lan.
title_en: Text Chapter 7 The Deep Sea Clan
